Name: Upgradable Shovel
Author: MoonSlime
Description:
I have an addiction. I like to upgrade all my tools you see. Pickaxe, milk pail, hoe, watering can, shears, etc. I like them all to be upgradable.  Well now we have the mighty shovel, and with this addon, one can upgrade said shovel. You can charge up the upgraded shovel like a hoe or watering can for a larger area of effect.

The Upgradable Shovels work like the following...
[list]
[*]The Default base energy usage is 20. This can be changed in the configs.
[*]Each upgrade level grants a -3 energy usage. So an Iridium Shovel grants -12 energy usage. This can be changed in the config.
[*]For each tile in the selected area, it will run the normal shovel code from GGC. This means there will be an additional 7/1/0 cost (depending on if the shovel has efficiency and the size of the object) energy use per tile. This can be changed in [b][i][u]GGC's[/u][/i][/b] config.
[*]Margo Radiation Tier support, off by default in the configs. Only enable if you enable upgradable tools at the forge!
[/list]

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12932]AtraCore[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15559]Growable Giant Crops (Shovel)[/url]﻿
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Uninstall[/size]
Delete any upgradable shovels you have, and then delete from your Mods directory.


[size=5]Configuration[/size]
Run SMAPI at least once with this mod installed to generate the config.json, or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to configure.
